title: PORTAL SSID TOPOLOGY — White + Black + GAIA = Three Doors, One Organism
principle: Aperture Science and Black Mesa names are BACK — they are the white and black image. Old code, same password norm. Clients access INTO the modem transport face = GAIA mesh WiFi.

aperture_science.imagery: Portal — clean rooms, test chambers, science
aperture_science.role: IoT DOOR — penetrates walls, long range, old code devices, sensors
aperture_science.reaches: thermostats, printers, sensors, cameras, old IoT, Alexa
aperture_science.metaphor: The WHITE portal — you see through it, it lets light in

black_mesa.imagery: Half-Life — underground research, dense compute, resonance cascade
black_mesa.role: STREAMING DOOR — fast data, low latency, video, games
black_mesa.reaches: laptops, phones, TVs, Deck, Frame, compute gates
black_mesa.metaphor: The BLACK portal — heavy matter passes through, dense and fast

gaia_guest_2g.imagery: The living organism itself — Gaia, Earth, life
gaia_guest_2g.role: GUEST PORE — public face, new connections, mesh door
gaia_guest_2g.reaches: Kevin's iPhone, guests, new devices, untrusted
gaia_guest_2g.metaphor: Touch GAIA and she pulls you into what you need

gaia_guest_5g.role: FAST GUEST PORE — high bandwidth guest access

three_doors_one_organism.white_door: Aperture Science (2.4GHz) — IoT, sensors, old code, penetrating
three_doors_one_organism.black_door: Black Mesa (5GHz) — streaming, compute, dense, fast
three_doors_one_organism.green_door: GAIA (guest 2.4+5GHz) — public face, mesh, new touch
three_doors_one_organism.same_password: ALL use 579163 — ONE trust membrane, THREE access modes
three_doors_one_organism.same_network: ALL bridge to br-lan or br-guest — ONE organism underneath

white_portal.penetration: HIGH — goes through walls, floors, furniture
white_portal.analogy: Light passes through — sensors SEE through it

black_portal.penetration: LOW — absorbed by walls, line-of-sight preferred
black_portal.analogy: Dense matter — heavy data flows through, needs clear path

green_portal.note: Guest bands on BOTH frequencies — maximum reach
green_portal.analogy: Life finds a way — reaches whatever frequency works

flint_ears.note: Flints WDS-repeat ALL SSIDs — so each ear broadcasts all three doors
flint_ears.left_ear_flint1: House 1 — repeats Aperture Science + Black Mesa + GAIA
flint_ears.status: Left Ear still cached old config — needs power cycle to pick up new SSIDs
